title: 第1章 完了！穿越到老太监作者的漫画里了!
slug: 我在致郁番里画热血番
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

雾岛八中。

当新的转学生江黛背着书包，穿着一身洗得发白的校服站在讲台上自我介绍时…

已经身穿到了这里一段时间的贺舟，眼前忽然出现了陌生的文字。

【所以又是一部挂着热血番名头的妖魔都市阴间恋爱致郁番？】

【简介不是一个奶牛猫变成的妖怪女主和主角之一的路安加入集结其他主角团对抗妖魔的故事吗？】

【估计又是夹杂着无病呻吟的各种乱七八糟桥段的俗套恋爱加BE美学，感觉拉完了，作者群里说了结局妖魔BE人类。】

【无聊，早说BE啊！神经！哪个热血番BE的？挂个热血番给我骗进来，不看了。】

漫画番？

奶牛……猫？

贺舟盯着眼前的文字发呆，下意识瞥了一眼讲台上的女主角江黛。

她穿着一身黑色的校服，十分保守带着宽松的款式。

此时，她正低着头，只能惊鸿一瞥的看到她校服领口露出来的纤细洁白的后颈，以及细枝硕果的身材。

“江黛同学是从岛外转学过来的，今天是第一次来我们学校。”

“以后大家就是同学了。”

“……”

其他人看了一眼，要么沉默，要么往后一仰，感叹：“又是一个带着秘密来的人。”

“哈，果然啊，雾岛的天，从来没晴过。”

对话这么文艺的漫画番？

怪不得这些天感觉这个世界处处透着诡异，大家对话文绉绉酸不拉几的，根本不像正常人。

晚自习也没有，每天四五点就下课了，全都是一副死气沉沉的样子。

原来自己穿越到漫画番里了？

随后，贺舟忽然想到了什么，鸡皮疙瘩都起来了，眼神逐渐茫然。

这不会是女漫画作家吧？

女作者的‘热血番’最可怕了，战力全看感情浓度！角色死不死全看作者心情！

妖怪都市？妖怪！！

上周似乎就有一个学生消失了，只是……学校说是说转学。

想起了结局是妖魔BE人类时，贺舟哆嗦了一下。

真危了！

老子的叮呢？

你给我叮啊！

因为没有人说话，老师抬了抬眼镜，扫了一眼，目光落在路安旁边的空位：“这样吧，江黛同学，你就坐在…”

“就坐在我边上吧！”

贺舟几乎是没有考虑地就立马举手站起来，摆出了最友善的笑容。

“老师，我愿意跟江黛同学同桌！”

这是女主吗？

这可是猫猫召唤兽！

虽然学校里有特殊能力的实验班，可自己在的那可是普通班啊！

只是从刚刚的弹幕里，贺舟就已经大概猜测出这个故事的走向，以及自己的身份。

不知名作者的一个漫画世界里一个光荣的NPC，用的还是自己的身体！

虽然不知道这是怎么做到的。

穿越过来后就顶替了这个跟自己同名同姓，并且长得一模一样的NPC身份。

NPC本来也不引人注目。

教室里的气氛沉寂下来。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Kirishima Eighth Middle School.

When the new transfer student Jiang Dai stood on the podium carrying a schoolbag and wearing a white washed school uniform to introduce herself...

He Zhou, who had been here for a while, suddenly saw strange words in front of his eyes.

[So it’s another depressing drama about love in the underworld in a demon city with the title of a hot-blooded drama?】

[Introduction Isn’t it a story about a cow-cat-turned-monster heroine and one of the protagonists, Lu An, joining a group of other protagonists to fight against the demon?】

[I guess it’s another cliched romance with BE aesthetics mixed with all kinds of nonsense and nonsense. It feels like it’s finished. The author group said that the ending is demon BE human.】

[Boring, I should have said BE earlier!nerve!Which hot-blooded fan is BE?You tricked me into watching a hot-blooded show, so I stopped watching it.】

Comics?

Cows...cats?

He Zhou stared at the text in front of him in a daze, and subconsciously glanced at the heroine Jiang Dai on the podium.

She was wearing a black school uniform, which was very conservative and loose-fitting.

At this time, she was lowering her head, and could only catch a glimpse of the slender and white back of her neck exposed by the collar of her school uniform, as well as her slender figure.

"Jiang Dai is a transfer student from outside the island. Today is the first time she comes to our school."

"We will all be classmates from now on."

"..."

The others glanced at it and either remained silent or leaned back and sighed: "Another person comes with a secret."

"Ha, as expected, the sky in Kirishima has never been clear."

A comic with such artistic dialogue?

No wonder the world seems to be full of weirdness these days. Everyone's conversations are sour and sour, and they don't look like normal people at all.

There was no evening self-study. Classes ended at four or five o'clock every day, and everything looked lifeless.

It turns out that I have traveled through time in a comic book?

Then, He Zhou suddenly thought of something, his skin got goosebumps, and his eyes gradually became blank.

Isn't this a female comic book writer?

The female author's "Hot-Blooded Episode" is the most terrifying, and the combat power all depends on the concentration of emotions!Whether the character dies or not depends on the author's mood!

Monster city?monster!!

It seems that a student disappeared last week, but... the school said he transferred to another school.

He Zhou shuddered when he remembered that the ending was about demons and humans.

How dangerous!

Where is my ding?

Give me a bite!

Because no one spoke, the teacher raised his glasses, glanced at the empty seat next to Lu An: "Let's do this, classmate Jiang Dai, you just sit..."

"Just sit next to me!"

He Zhou immediately raised his hands and stood up without thinking, putting on the most friendly smile.

"Teacher, I would like to sit at the same table as Jiang Dai!"

Is this the heroine?

This is a cat summoned beast!

Although there are experimental classes for special abilities in the school, the one I am in is an ordinary class!

Just from the barrage just now, He Zhou had roughly guessed the direction of the story and his own identity.

A glorious NPC in a comic book world by an unknown author, using his own body!

Don't know how this is done though.

After traveling through time, he took over the identity of this NPC who had the same name and surname as him and looked exactly the same.

NPCs are inherently unattractive.

The atmosphere in the classroom fell silent.
